employerProcess.description: 482 employer sponsorship can run concurrently across phases — you don't have to wait for one step to fully close before starting the next. Our process is designed to move efficiently without cutting corners.

phases.title: Eligibility & Role Assessment
bullets: Confirm the role is on the Core Skills Occupation List (CSOL) or applicable list
Assess Labour Market Testing (LMT) requirements for the position
Determine sponsorship status — apply for Standard Business Sponsorship if not yet held
RedBridge matches pre-screened candidates from our verified talent pool

phases.title: Sponsorship & Nomination Application
bullets: Lodge Standard Business Sponsorship (SBS) — approval and DOHA registration
Compile the complete 482 nomination package — no client chasing required
Document and analyse Labour Market Testing reports (2 periods, 4 months apart)
Lodge visa application jointly with the nominated candidate
Monitor application and respond to any Department requests

phases.title: Visa Grant & Ongoing Compliance
bullets: Visa granted — employee commences work under sponsorship conditions
Insight Idea tracks all visa milestone dates and compliance obligations
Sponsor notified of any material change obligations within the required 28-day window
RedBridge monitors placement alignment and flags any role or candidate changes
Optional pathway planning for 186 ENS transition after qualifying period
